description: D-003 option A ordinary-client friend-play proof with the invitee elected as the sole authority. The invitee launches first and accepts through signed presence, starts the in-client listen host, and publishes a typed signed match route; the initiator remains the inviter but performs one idempotent route join. Only the elected invitee owns the packed/enabled Needler fixture and spawn request; the clean initiator receives the public package through the authoritative ready gate before ordinary first-person gameplay/render verification.
